question: Which departments will tell a script what India notified — the outlay, the date, the list length — and in what shape?
note: Reachability and shape only. No figure is recorded from any page, including the ones that carry the figures this layer needs.
refusal: Money-shaped mentions are counted, never read. A scheme outlay copied into this file would be a number with a filename beside it instead of a source, which is the exact failure lib/policy-measures.ts is built to prevent. Extraction is a separate connector and it must store the sentence.
knownLimits: PIB has no keyword search that answers a GET. Releases are addressed by numeric PRID and the search is a POST form, so the PIB targets confirm reachability and nothing else.
Several ministry scheme paths here are guesses. A 404 tells the next run to crawl the schemes index; nothing downstream assumes a guessed path resolves.
A reachable page is not an answering page. Look at found/missing and the shape block before believing a target is usable.

findings.what: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
findings.note: The root, probed first so a dead scheme path can be told apart from a dead ministry.
If any single page settles the electronics outlays, it is this one. Everything else here is a fallback for it.
Path taken from the ministry's own group naming. A 404 sends the next run to the schemes index.

findings.what: MeitY: production-linked incentive for IT hardware
findings.note: Two versions of this scheme exist and the second replaced the first. Whatever answers must date itself or it cannot fill either slot.

findings.what: MeitY: scheme for electronic components and semiconductors

findings.note: What is wanted here is a table — parts, duty, year — not a headline figure. A page that carries the schedule as a PDF is a success.
probe-semiconductor.ts asks this host about approved projects. This asks it about the programme's outlay and its sanction date.
The count that matters is how many product categories are notified, and it is a list length rather than a headline.

findings.what: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs
findings.note: Duty rates change every budget. Any rate read from here is worthless without the year it applies to.
The domestic earmark in defence capital acquisition is a budget line, which makes it the most legible figure in this whole layer.

findings.what: DDP: indigenisation and the positive indigenisation lists
findings.note: The single most important target in this file. Five services lists and an unknown number of component lists, each with a date, a length and a staggered embargo schedule.
Wanted here: the designation year and the node count. The investment figures already exist as sourced series and must not be duplicated.
A public list of what the defence manufacturers still import — a rarer thing than the lists of what they no longer may.
Expect activity counts — challenges, startups, grants. The figure that would be a finding is contracts awarded, and it is usually not published.
The procedure is a long PDF. The probe wants the link, not the document — the offset threshold and the indigenous-content floors are inside it and need a page read.
The annual report is the one document that restates every defence measure in one place with a year attached. If it is reachable as a PDF, it is the best target in this file.

findings.what: Comptroller and Auditor General audit reports
findings.note: Offsets contracted and offsets discharged are different numbers. Only the auditor publishes the second, which is why an audit site is in a probe about policy.

findings.what: DPIIT consolidated foreign direct investment policy
Uttar Pradesh Expressways Industrial Development Authority
findings.note: The UP corridor is administered by the state, so the node-level detail lives here rather than with the ministry.

findings.what: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
findings.note: Carried because solar is the control case: the same instrument, and a trade line that did not do what the story says.
